scenario: A corporate treasury analyst has a portfolio of foreign-currency receivables (EUR, GBP, JPY) and needs to: (1) convert each exposure to USD at current spot rates, (2) calculate the cost of forward-hedging the total USD exposure, and (3) produce a board-level FX exposure and hedging memo.
info_flow: currency-exchange converts each foreign-currency receivable to USD at spot rates → financial-calculator computes the hedge notional and forward premium cost → reporting drafts the FX exposure and hedging recommendation memo.
